resources.string: E-Paper Launcher uses this accessibility service to apply a visual filter that transforms your screen into an e-ink/paper style for reduced eye strain and distraction-free usage. The service only detects app-switch events to trigger page-turn animations and draws the visual overlay. It does NOT read, log, or transmit any screen content or personal data.

To apply the e-paper filter system-wide, E-Paper Launcher needs permission to capture your screen. This is used ONLY for real-time visual filtering - captured frames are processed on-device, never stored or transmitted. You can revoke this permission anytime in system settings.
